note: Scenario registry for run-scenario.sh. Ids follow research/simulation/PLAN.md section 3. 'pack' holds the arguments passed to cfd/make_pack.py. 'status' says what has actually been run. 'deviations' lists every place where the registered case differs from PLAN.md; each one is also logged in PLAN.md section 9. Common to all: kerb 0.2 m (castellated grid; PLAN 0.15 m); grade 'fast' (5 cm kerb-lane tailpipe cells, 10 cm near the headline scooter and its probes, 20 cm over the pack) because PLAN's 2.5 cm/5 cm resolution costs about 47 h per 90 s on 3 cores; spin-up 30 s from the mean wind (PLAN 60 s); one red per run (PLAN asks 5 reds; more reds = rerun with --reds, see run-scenario.sh). UPDATE 2026-11-27 (matrix run, PLAN 9.17-9.19): all cases now use the 'coarse' grade with lean refinement extents (10 cm tailpipe cells on 0.2 m muffler faces, 10 cm bodies of kerb-lane scooters, 20 cm over the pack and round the probes) and the 'rfm' structured inflow (large-scale wander + convected random Fourier modes, precomputed boundary data). Results of the earlier try-3 build proof are kept in results/S1-try3, G0-try3, S4-try3.
